meta.title: Select Quote + Long-Text Capsule + Edit + Undo
meta.description: Select text to copy it or attach it to the composer as a quote chip (hover for the full text); pasting long text folds it into a capsule chip, and clicking a capsule in a sent message opens the detail tab in the native right sidebar (JSON auto-formatted and highlighted; degrades to a local drawer without the sidebar service); drag the composer's top-edge grip to resize the input (capped at 60vh, double-click resets); hover your own messages for time / copy / edit / undo — edits are sent as a new message, while undo rewinds the message, restores the files its turn changed, and refills the original text and quote chips into the composer. Clicking a quote capsule in the composer scrolls back to the source line and underlines it (click again to clear).
